en: You beat every trainer in my house? Now that's the hottest thing I've seen all summer!
Here, have a cold drink on me. Have six, actually!
If you want more, I'll sell you some. Just come and ask.
Welcome to the Seashore House! The trainers in here are hot to battle.
Beat all of them, and I'll treat you to something cool to drink.
Want a Soda Pop? Nothing beats the heat like a fizzy drink!
